notices.text: Messages already received keep trailing spaces that make the last word of a line wrap onto a line of its own at 80 columns, most of all in OTHERNETS, until they are rendered again. Run node src/tools/maintenance.js --regen-html with the worker running (add --area SHORTCODE to do one area first), even if you ran it after updating to 0.9.11a. It changes nothing but how stored messages are displayed.

QWK packets now live in one directory per link and role: qnet/<ID>.hub/ for a system that is your hub, qnet/<ID>.node/ for one that is your node. The update moves what is already in qnet/ and leaves qnet/<ID> as a link to the node directory, so a Synchronet node calling through qnet-directory.js keeps working. When you next change that node's call-out, point it at the qnet/<ID>.node path shown on its connection in the peer page.
